window_overlap_note: neighboring patches overlap; patch-cluster intervals still share underlying ground and are not fully independent

sample_processed_metadata.landslide_class_coding: 0 non-landslide; 1/2/3 landslide (NASA inventory raster; ann>0 = landslide)

dem_derivatives: slope from 30 m elevation gradient; downhill aspect; reprojected to each SAR patch; GLO-30 provenance is the existing audit record, DEM file tags themselves do not identify source/version

terrain_matched_change.method: within each patch, BothValid positives matched to background within exact 5-bin slope x 9-bin aspect (flat separate) x 8-bin elevation strata; GT-count weighted

possible_temporal_mismatch_proxy.candidate_rule: GT fraction >=2%, at least one BothValid GT pixel; one orbit GT/BG |ΔVV| contrast >=1.20, other <=1.05, ratio >=1.5
possible_temporal_mismatch_proxy.interpretation: possible temporal/orbit-view discordance; not a mislabeled-polygon determination

registration_shift_sensitivity.metric: ASC |ΔVV|, patch-cluster GT-minus-BG mean; GT translated with clipped no-wrap border

Case_A.rule: gt_frac>=0.03, >=90% GT BothValid, both orbit invalid<5%; retain >=P75 max GT/BG |ΔVV| contrast; nearest eligible median

Case_B.rule: GT>=2%; ASC invalid overlap>=70% and >=50% of ASC-invalid GT is layover; DESC invalid overlap<=30%; nearest pool median

Case_C.rule: GT>=2%; DESC invalid overlap>=50% and >=25% of DESC-invalid GT is layover; ASC invalid overlap<=30%; nearest pool median

Case_D.rule: GT>=2%; highest mean percentile rank across bilateral weak event contrast, bilateral GT-mask overlap, low-slope GT, inverse DEM-slope/mask association, ASC/DESC contrast discordance; flagged candidate only, not an error finding

temporal_proxy_filter_correction.note: The first audit pass ranked Type5 anomalies before applying the GT>=2% eligibility filter. The primary audit statistics were unaffected. This finalizer applied GT>=2% and BothValid GT eligibility before computing candidate counts and the Type5 top-k list.

gt_boundary_change_alignment.method: inside BothValid: 1-pixel inner GT contour = GT minus 3x3 binary erosion; average hypot(|ΔVV|,|ΔVH|) over ASC and DESC; compare contour with all BothValid background
gt_boundary_change_alignment.limitation: rasterized GT contour proxy only; no original vectors or optical source images locally; not a boundary registration validation and not terrain matched
